commands.command: test -f configs/demo/mappings-sandbox.yaml && git check-ignore -q configs/demo/mappings-sandbox.yaml && ! git ls-files --error-unmatch configs/demo/mappings-sandbox.yaml 2>/dev/null
grep -q '^## Seed run 2026-10-19' configs/demo/README.md && grep -q '^## Running the seed' configs/demo/README.md

grep -qE 'read-back: [0-9]+ ok, 0 mismatch' configs/demo/README.md && grep -qE '^read-back: [0-9]+ ok, 0 mismatch' .scratch/l4-seed/seed-reset.txt && grep -q '^done: elapsed' .scratch/l4-seed/seed-reset.txt
grep -E '^\| L4 Data and agent \|' docs/demo/STATUS.md | grep -q 'claude/demo-l4-data-and-agent' && ! grep -E '^\| L4 Data and agent \|' docs/demo/STATUS.md | grep -q 'can start now'
test $(grep -c '^L4 -> L0' docs/demo/STATUS.md) -ge 2 && grep -q '^L4 -> L2' docs/demo/STATUS.md
